text: Security is a key part of web development. First, always use HTTPS to encrypt data between the user and the server. This protects passwords and personal information from attackers. Second, strong authentication is essential. Users should create complex passwords, and two-factor authentication adds extra safety. Third, validate all input carefully. Never trust what users type into forms, because common vulnerabilities like SQL injection and cross-site scripting (XSS) often start there. Finally, keep your software updated and follow safe coding practices. By combining these steps, developers can build websites that are much harder to attack and safer for everyone to use.
